entities.summary: Petr Hannig (b. 1946-01-20, Neštěmice) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Neštěmice and Czech Republic. Known in the fields of czech republic, composers & musicians, europe.
